newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Ten killed in Pakistani tribal feud.
newsitem.headline: Ten killed in Pakistani tribal feud.

text.p: Gunmen killed 10 people when they sprayed bullets into a roadside tea shop from a car in the southern Pakistani province of Sindh on Thursday, police said.
Police said they believed men from the Ujjan tribe shot at members of the rival Jatoi tribe as part of a tribal feud. The gunmen escaped after the shooting in a village near the town of Khairpur.
More than 100 people have been killed in clashes between tribes in the area in the past three years.

Residents said the latest shooting might have shattered a reconciliation deal brokered by local authorities last year. They said many members of the Ujjan tribe immediately went into hiding, fearing retaliation by Jatois.
